title: Co-Constructing Alignment: A Participatory Approach to Situate AI Values

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation using a 'Misalignment Diary' where participants documented instances of LLM outputs disproportionately favoring American contexts and perspectives in research tasks.

Qualitative evaluation via user diaries recording instances where LLMs provided narrowed interpretations, failed to ground theories in primary literature, or gave ethically problematic research design guidance that clashed with specific academic paradigms.

Participatory workshops combining asynchronous diary studies and generative design activities to identify and unpack contextual value frictions (e.g., relating to research integrity, human care, and sustainability) during real-world human-LLM interactions.
